integrity: The classical delay equation, its positive equilibrium, positivity and oscillation results were checked in the comprehensive Berezansky–Braverman–Idels review. Its model/equilibrium/oscillation sections were inspected and document-wide searches found no occurrences of `average`, `moment` or `mean`. A complete open 2016 same-equation article was inspected at its classical-model definition and literature review, with the same three document-wide searches returning no matches. The 1980 source was used for provenance and its verified public date. The stationary balance, covariance, strict Jensen equality case and variance consequence were independently reconstructed, and the algebraic consequences were replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for compact time-translation-invariant probability laws on complete strictly positive solutions.
It excludes extinction-supported measures, stochastic forcing and nonautonomous coefficients.
The size-biased moment floor does not determine the ordinary stationary mean by itself.
The delayed-recruitment variance inequality is not asserted to be sharp for every parameter choice.
The original 1980 article was checked from public metadata and abstract rather than complete full text.
A short equivalent stationary balance could remain in older unindexed applied literature.
title: A stationary size-biased moment floor and delayed-recruitment covariance law for Nicholson's blowflies
